cases.translation: Moses and Aaron came to Pharaoh.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to/toward) always governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Я не знаю ___ и не отпущу Израиль.
cases.translation: I do not know Yahweh and will not let Israel go.
cases.explain: Господь is the direct object of знать; for animate masculine nouns the accusative equals the genitive, Господа.

cases.sentence: Чтобы он не наказал нас ___ или мечом.
cases.translation: …lest he punish us with pestilence or the sword.
cases.explain: The means of the action (наказать чем — punish with what) is expressed in the instrumental case.

cases.translation: Why do you take the people away from their work?
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) always governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: И народ рассеялся по ___ собирать жневье.
cases.translation: And the people scattered throughout Egypt to gather stubble.
cases.explain: The preposition по (over/throughout) governs the dative case.

cases.translation: The fault lies on your own people.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Чтобы он устроил мне ___ в пустыне.
cases.translation: …that he may hold a feast to me in the wilderness.
cases.explain: праздник is the direct object of устроил; an inanimate masculine noun has accusative equal to nominative.

cases.translation: The people have now become many.
cases.explain: народ is the subject of стал, so it takes the nominative, the dictionary form.

reading.ru: Я не знаю Господа и не отпущу Израиль
reading.question: What does Pharaoh say about Yahweh?
options: He does not know Yahweh and will not release Israel
He knows Yahweh and fears him
He will release Israel at once
reading.correct: He does not know Yahweh and will not release Israel
reading.explain: Pharaoh denies knowing Yahweh and refuses to let Israel go.

reading.ru: В тот же день фараон приказал надсмотрщикам над народом и старостам.
reading.question: What did Pharaoh do that same day?
reading.explain: The text says Pharaoh gave orders to the taskmasters over the people and the officers.

reading.ru: Не давайте больше этому народу солому для изготовления кирпичей, пусть идут и собирают сами, но требуйте от них такое же количество кирпичей, как и прежде.
reading.question: What change did Pharaoh order regarding straw and bricks?
options: Stop giving straw but demand the same number of bricks
reading.correct: Stop giving straw but demand the same number of bricks
reading.explain: The people must gather their own straw yet still make the same quota of bricks as before.

reading.ru: И народ рассеялся по Египту собирать жневье, чтобы заменить им солому.
reading.question: Why did the people scatter throughout Egypt?
options: To gather stubble to replace the straw
reading.correct: To gather stubble to replace the straw
reading.explain: They spread out to collect stubble as a substitute for the straw they were denied.

reading.question: What do the officers point out to Pharaoh?
options: That his servants are being beaten
reading.correct: That his servants are being beaten
reading.explain: The officers protest that Pharaoh's own servants are being beaten.

reading.ru: С тех пор, как я ходил к фараону говорить от твоего имени, он стал обращаться с народом еще более жестоко.
reading.question: According to Moses, what happened since he spoke to Pharaoh in God's name?
options: Pharaoh treated the people even more cruelly
reading.correct: Pharaoh treated the people even more cruelly
reading.explain: Moses complains that since he spoke in God's name Pharaoh has dealt more harshly with the people.
